I haven't made an edit, because I can't write one safely. The outline shows `addLoad` at lines 562–577 but not its body. I can't see how it refuses items, tidies and matches the label, or what it returns, and your instruction is to keep all of that unchanged. A SEARCH block would have to copy the body exactly, so a guess would either be refused or change behaviour you want kept.

Please paste lines 562–577 of `src/manifest.ts`, plus `squash` (line 180) if the label tidying uses it. The change itself is small: add a unit-weight comparison, `row.unitKg === item.unitKg`, to the condition that finds an existing row. No match still appends a new row at the end.
